page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column, with marginal notes in the left margin: "Nota" beside the first line and a multi-line note "Vrbs Groningæ emporium quondam celebre," beside the middle of the text. Page number and running head at the top.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: Notarii in membrana exaratis anno M. cccc. xvi, quæ literæ arguunt, eos .tum colligendo tributo per Agrum præfuisse, quemadmodum per Urbem Consules. Et rursum nominatos inveni in literis Occonis Broecmerii Kenonis filii anno M. cccc. xvii scriptis & signatis mense Augusto, atque ita nominatos, ut tractasse pecuniam publicam totius provinciæ cum Consulibus oppidanis sit manifestum. Iterumque anno M.cccc.xx iv.nomen eorum in publico transactionis instrumento impressum animadverti. Post quod tempus cum exissent adhuc anni xii, jam continuum eorum indicem, qui in eo munere fuerunt ad Saxonica usque bella per annos circiter lxiii, quandiu libera & sine principe Resp. hæc manfit, curia ad servat. Sed de his infra rursum. Urbem autem hancemporium fuisse antiquitus vicinis regionibus, præcipue Staverana fortuna ruente, nec solum propinquas sed etiam longinquas negotiationes factitasse, ac in possessione earum floruisse, maritimaque non minus quam mediterranea commercia coluisse, extra controversiamVrbs Gro- ingæ[?] em- porium quondam celebre, siam

page.notes: Marginal note "Vrbs Groningæ emporium quondam celebre," is printed in three short lines with hyphens; the reading "ingæ" is uncertain in the scan. The printed "eos .tum" has a stray space before "tum" and "xx iv" has a space inside the numeral; both are kept as printed. The last line "siam" is set at the right after "controver-" and is joined to it. The bottom edge of the scan carries a digitiser's watermark, not transcribed.
